description: A quiet snow-country mechanical baby macaque with very thick winter fur, a pink sleepy face, a brass buckle scarf collar, and a small wind-up key on its back.

idle.notes: Quiet bundled idle with tiny breathing motion and a sleepy half-lidded expression.

walk_right.notes: True right-facing slow bundled snow-walk with the collar, face, and back key all facing right.

walk_left.notes: True left-facing slow bundled snow-walk with the collar, face, and back key all facing left.

curious.notes: Mild curious lift with a gentle more-awake look while keeping Pico shy and soft.

happy.notes: Warm pleased reaction with paws lifting toward the face and chest, not a loud greeting wave.

sleep.notes: Curled sleep ball with closed eyes while the scarf buckle and back key remain visible.

shake.notes: Compact shiver-and-snow-shake extra where snow stays close to the fur silhouette.

warm_up.notes: Non-directional paw-rubbing warm-up loop with tucked shoulders and no detached effects.

gift_react.notes: Tiny delighted lift and settle used for gentle received-a-gift reactions.

sunbathe.notes: No dedicated atlas row was available; the curled warm resting row is the closest sun-warmed approximation.

drag.notes: Directional drag reuses the true-facing walking rows.

sunbathe.notes: Atlas row budget did not allow a dedicated sunbathe strip, so the curled warm resting row is used as the nearest fit.

dragFacingValidation.rule: deltaX < 0 => facing left; deltaX > 0 => facing right
manualVerification: left drag uses the left-facing walk row and right drag uses the right-facing walk row
walk_left and walk_right are not swapped
the brass buckle scarf collar stays attached and agrees with body direction in both rows
the back wind-up key stays attached and agrees with body direction in both rows
the pink face, sleepy eyes, and thick winter-fur bundle remain readable at small size
